## Overview Align the existing DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash MI355X AgentX preset with [InferenceX #4480](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4480), extending the [#4409 profiles](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63344) now represented as tuned presets by [#63560](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/63560). **Ready for review. Merge dependency:** resolve the source PR's [OperatorX capture-selection finding](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4480#discussion_r4369225363), then re-freeze #4480 and confirm these profile values before merging this recipe update. The finding remains reproducible at the audited source head. ## Claims Only `recipes/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml` changes. The six low-concurrency points gain the exact source scheduling limits: | Points | Max sequences | Batched tokens | Graph capture maximum | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | | TP4 c1/c2; TP2 c1/c2/c4 | 1 | 32768 | 8 | | TP2 c8 | 2 | 8192 | 16 | TP2 c16/c32 retain sequence caps 4/8 and 8192-token budgets; c64 keeps `max-num-seqs` unset (the engine default) and its 16384-token budget. All three retain capture 1024. Baseline commands, other hardware/presets, the pinned image, model/draft configuration and quantization remain unchanged. The preset keeps real block rejection. Synthetic acceptance remains a throughput-only qualification method. These workload-specific caps target interactivity and can increase queueing, TTFT or end-to-end latency; no throughput gain is claimed. ## Validation Source: [audited head `8ea833ccd`](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/tree/8ea833ccdb4a438c4da4bf10eaac0bc834c09855), [resolved recipe](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/blob/8ea833ccdb4a438c4da4bf10eaac0bc834c09855/inferencex-e2e/benchmarks/single_node/srt-slurm-recipes/dsv41flash/vllm/mi355x-fp4-mtp/agentic.yaml). [Run 40161856449, attempt 3](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40161856449/attempts/3) passed all nine selected performance points at `7cd3fae34dfe9149b8f9436795edab11a3ef8541`: [TP4 c1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40161856449/job/121144693777), [TP4 c2](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40161856449/job/121144694347), [TP2 c1](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40161856449/job/121144694355), [c2](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40161856449/job/121144693882), [c4](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40161856449/job/121144694178), [c8](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40161856449/job/121144694587). Its independent [TP2 c64 accuracy job](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40161856449/job/121144694312) also passed. The serving recipe, selected matrix, image and binding/runtime sources match the audited head; the latest commit changes changelog prose only. This is source-compatible evidence, not an exact-head GPU rerun or independent accuracy verification of every point. Wrapper run `40258824212` skipped actual performance/eval matrices and is not used as fresh runtime evidence. No local GPU serving/eval was run. Local checks against recipes renderer `0bfb0e97b2cfe5651d680a2e74d0585b5c3a2880`: ```bash pre-commit run --files recipes/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.yaml # Renderer checkout, with VLLM_CHECKOUT pointing to the candidate source: node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir "$VLLM_CHECKOUT/recipes" node scripts/sync-sources.mjs node scripts/build-recipes-api.mjs pnpm test:presets pnpm test:schema pnpm test:overlay pnpm test:guide-html ``` All passed: presets 14/14, schema 4/4, overlay 7/7, guide HTML 29/29. Actual command synthesis checked all 18 MI355X point/checkpoint combinations: only the six intended points changed the three scheduling flags; 40 Baseline and 50 other-preset renderings stayed identical. Chrome browser checks passed all 18 Serve selections, both checkpoint variants' Verify/Bench commands, Baseline restoration, and the runbook/provenance display. These checks validate generated commands and page behavior, not GPU execution. Source runtime qualification used 0909; the inherited selectable 1017 option has no new runtime qualification in this PR. ## Details The current schema represents client-concurrency profiles as preset points, so this updates the existing `mi355x_agentx` points instead of adding duplicate launch commands to the guide. The preset remains opt-in. Searches of open/merged work found no competing #4480 recipe update; #63560 migrated the older profiles without these six scheduling changes. AI assistance: Codex prepared the change and validation using `golden-review` and vLLM's `pr-checklist`. Submitted for human review. ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

@@ -5,7 +5,7 @@ meta:
   provider: "DeepSeek"
   description: "DeepSeek V4.1 Flash vision-language MoE (552B backbone; 8B active per prompt token, 16B per output token) combining sliding-window plus compressed sparse attention with a two-level indexer, engram n-gram memory, hyper-connections, and a DSpark multi-token draft head."
   date_added: 2026-09-09
-  date_updated: 2026-10-23
+  date_updated: 2026-10-25
   tasks:
     - text
     - multimodal
@@ -899,8 +899,8 @@ presets:
     # The lane served the 0909 launch checkpoint; 1017 shares its format and memory layout.
     variants: [fp8, default]
     workload: "Agentic (InferenceX AgentX)"
-    description: "TP2 for concurrency 1 to 64, with 8192-token prefill chunks and a sequence cap at 16 and 32, and TP4 with resident Engram tables at 1 and 2; graphs captured to 1024 tokens."
-    source: { label: "InferenceX #4409", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4409", key: "dsv41flash-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark", revision: 7afd3b8 }
+    description: "TP2 for concurrency 1 to 64 with Engram CPU offload, and TP4 at 1 and 2 with resident Engram tables; per-point sequence caps, prefill budgets and graph sizes tuned for AgentX interactivity."
+    source: { label: "InferenceX #4480", href: "https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4480", key: "dsv41flash-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark", revision: 8ea833ccd }
     image: "vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-e68efc685ab1e6f1eda004ced7157e3ca411da2f@sha256:520e098f54ec96837228aaddea0a833cbf6374dbdffd480c1d65f26ffab7701b"
     select:
       frontend: rust
@@ -916,16 +916,44 @@ presets:
       tp2_c1:
         label: "1 (TP2)"
         concurrency: 1
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "1"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "32768"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "8"
       tp2_c2:
         label: "2 (TP2)"
         concurrency: 2
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "1"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "32768"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "8"
       tp2_c4:
         label: "4 (TP2)"
         concurrency: 4
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "1"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "32768"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "8"
       tp2_c8:
         label: "8 (TP2)"
         concurrency: 8
         default: true
+        args:
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "2"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "8192"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "16"
       tp2_c16:
         label: "16 (TP2)"
         concurrency: 16
@@ -953,6 +981,12 @@ presets:
         args:
           - "--engram-config"
           - '{"cpu_offload":false}'
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "1"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "32768"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "8"
       tp4_c2:
         label: "2 (TP4)"
         concurrency: 2
@@ -961,10 +995,24 @@ presets:
         args:
           - "--engram-config"
           - '{"cpu_offload":false}'
+          - "--max-num-seqs"
+          - "1"
+          - "--max-num-batched-tokens"
+          - "32768"
+          - "--max-cudagraph-capture-size"
+          - "8"
     runbook: |
-      Excess sessions queue behind the sequence cap at c16 and c32. Throughput runs replace
-      block rejection with DSpark's golden acceptance length (3.51); the preset keeps real
-      block rejection, as the lane's accuracy eval and ordinary serving do.
+      Excess sessions queue behind the sequence cap. These settings target AgentX p90
+      interactivity; assess queueing, TTFT, end-to-end latency and throughput for your
+      traffic. The c16/c32 limits from [#4409](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4409)
+      and the 1024-token graph cap at c16/c32/c64 are retained.
+
+      [InferenceX run 40161856449, attempt 3](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/40161856449/attempts/3)
+      passed all nine performance points and its TP2 c64 accuracy job at `7cd3fae`.
+      The serving configuration is unchanged at audited head `8ea833ccd`; this is not
+      an exact-head rerun or a claim of an independent accuracy job for every point.
+      Throughput runs use DSpark's synthetic golden acceptance length (3.51); the
+      preset keeps real block rejection for ordinary serving and accuracy evaluation.
 
   gb300_agentx_pd:
     label: "AgentX PD"
@@ -1304,10 +1352,10 @@ guide: |
   ### AgentX on MI355X
 
   The **AgentX TP2** preset (opt-in;
-  [InferenceX #4409](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4409)) renders the
-  lane on its pinned ROCm image: TP2 for concurrency 1 to 64, with 8192-token prefill
-  chunks and at most 4 (c16) or 8 (c32) running sequences, and TP4 with the Engram tables
-  resident at concurrency 1 and 2, graphs captured to 1024 tokens. The lane served
+  [InferenceX #4480](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4480)) renders the
+  lane on its pinned ROCm image: TP2 for concurrency 1 to 64 with Engram CPU offload,
+  and TP4 at concurrency 1 and 2 with resident Engram tables. Its points carry the
+  corresponding sequence caps, prefill budgets and graph sizes. The lane served
   **FP8 (0909)**. These limits are workload-specific, not generic defaults.
 
   ## MI300X Tensor Parallel
